_comment: Reviewed platform disposition of The Document Foundation's LibreOffice CVE records (security plan v19 §9.5.10.2, R18-1). An entry counts only while descriptionSha256 equals the SHA-256 of the record's English CNA description. 'all'/'macos' → the advisory may apply to the macOS website build; a list without them → never published for macOS; no entry → unknown. Records with structured platforms (CVE-2021-25631 Windows, CVE-2025-14714 MacOS) need no entry. Deliberately unresolved (unknown): CVE-2023-6185 (GStreamer integration, platform not stated), CVE-2024-5261 (LibreOfficeKit mode only). Change only by a reviewed commit naming the reviewer.

absentRecords.evidence: named on https://www.libreoffice.org/about-us/security/advisories/ but https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2021-25632 answers CVE_RECORD_DNE and cvelistV5 has no file (checked 2026-10-24)

deferred.reason: GStreamer integration; the description does not state whether the official macOS build uses it (reviewed: unresolved, stays unknown)
LibreOfficeKit mode only; not an established condition of the desktop app (reviewed: unresolved, stays unknown)
